section: Reports Suite > Work In Progress > WIP - Earned & Remaining
title: Only three reports carry Adjustments; the other three exclude them
refs: SV-8661 (WIP spec v28 2026-08-24 Story 5a S5a-R4 - the Adjustments treatment covers this report, Sales By Customer and Sales By Representative for this wave; other reports that total Labor and Parts only continue to exclude work-order-level fees and discounts, an inconsistency ruled known and parked by Chris Ward 2026-08-13; Story 5a carries no Jira story key of its own, so the owning story is Story 5 / SV-8661)
preconds:
1. You are signed in to the ShopView App on a desktop browser.
2. A ZZAUTOTEST work order exists that carries a work-order-level fee and a work-order-level discount, so it has a non-zero Adjustments value, and it has both approved labor and approved parts on it.
3. That work order has been invoiced, so it can appear in the reports that read invoiced work.
4. You can reach all six reports in the Reports area: Work In Progress, Sales By Customer, Sales By Representative, Technician Utilization, Parts Velocity and Inventory Value.
5. In each report you can open the column chooser, so you can see the full list of columns the report offers and not only the ones currently shown.
steps:
1. Open the Work In Progress report and look for an Adjustments column, both on screen and in the column chooser.
2. Do the same in the Sales By Customer report.
3. Do the same in the Sales By Representative report.
4. Open the Technician Utilization report and look for an Adjustments column, both on screen and in the column chooser.
5. Do the same in the Parts Velocity report.
6. Do the same in the Inventory Value report.
7. In Technician Utilization, Parts Velocity and Inventory Value, find any figure for the seeded work order's labor or parts and check the amount against the work order's own labor and parts values.
expected:
1. Work In Progress offers an Adjustments column.
2. Sales By Customer offers an Adjustments column.
3. Sales By Representative offers an Adjustments column, and it is still there with the calculations already specified for that report - nothing about it has been removed.
4. Technician Utilization offers no Adjustments column anywhere, neither on screen nor in its column chooser.
5. Parts Velocity offers no Adjustments column anywhere, neither on screen nor in its column chooser.
6. Inventory Value offers no Adjustments column anywhere, neither on screen nor in its column chooser.
7. In those three reports the labor and parts amounts for the seeded work order match the work order's own labor and parts values, with the work-order-level fee and the work-order-level discount left out of them entirely.
8. Adjustments belonging to this wave stop at those first three reports. The other three reporting on labor and parts only is the expected result here, not a missing feature - the difference between the two groups is known and has been left as it is for now.

---
This is the expected behaviour as per the Work In Progress report specification version 28 (Story 5a, S5a-R4), read on 28 August 2026, under epic SV-8582 and its summary-strip story SV-8661, which owns the Story 5a decisions. Story 5a records the 2026-08-13 design review and carries no Jira story key of its own.

AUTOMATION: READY
